blocker.summary: No admissible fixture exists. The 22 pre-existing replay.bin captures were all produced by another tree/binary AND all used pdcch_blind_monitor_full_auto=1 (VOID under the plan's TESTING MODE RULE). A new bounded capture was collected with the current binary through the manual launcher in the required full_auto=0 manual mode (see new_capture_attempts[1]) and is RF-valid (SIB1 seen, DL crc_ok 91.8%, UL crc_ok 83.2%, clean exit, no RXDISCONT/RFSTALL, binary matches the current build) -- but it produced NO replay.bin, and this is a structural, deterministic property of the current recorder code under manual mode, not RF variance: further capture attempts cannot change the outcome.
blocker.root_cause: nr_passive_replay_capture.c's nr_passive_replay_dl() only arms the recorder (RP_ARMED -> RP_REQUESTED) when a successful DL job carries job->sweep_ticket.generation != 0 (nr_passive_replay_capture.c:206-210, condition checked at line 206). sweep_ticket is populated ONLY inside the block gated by `if (g_pdsch_sweep_on && !is_dci10)` (nr_pdcch_blind_monitor_rt.c:2100-2107); outside that block every job's sweep_ticket is left zero-initialized (nr_pdcch_blind_monitor_rt.c:2098, `nr_pdsch_sweep_ticket_t sweep_ticket = {0};`). g_pdsch_sweep_on is set in pdsch_sweep_maybe_enable() to `ready = cfg->dl_full_auto && (...)` (nr_pdcch_blind_monitor_rt.c:164-184) -- i.e. it can only be true when pdcch_blind_monitor_full_auto=1. Under the plan's mandatory manual mode (pdcch_blind_monitor_full_auto=0, adaptive_manual_dlul.conf), cfg->dl_full_auto is always false, so g_pdsch_sweep_on is always false, so sweep_ticket.generation is always 0 for every DL job, so the recorder can never leave RP_ARMED and replay.bin is never written -- proven by reading the single call site of nr_pdsch_config_sweep_select() (nr_pdcch_blind_monitor_rt.c:2108, the only place sweep_ticket.generation is ever assigned a nonzero value), not inferred from this run alone.
blocker.why_not_fixed_here: P02's mandate is a narrow launcher opt-in (REPLAY=1 env passthrough) plus fixture audit/registration/checker infrastructure, not a change to production PDCCH/replay decode logic. Relaxing the arm condition for manual mode is a real design decision (what does 'settled' mean for a job with no sweep at all?) belonging to whoever owns nr_passive_replay_capture.c / nr_pdcch_blind_monitor_rt.c, and the plan explicitly forbids tuning code/config to manufacture a pass. Reported here as BLOCKED rather than patched.
blocker.attempts_exhausted_early: ATTEMPTS is capped at 3 per the brief, but only 2 were used: attempt 1 was VOID_RF_OR_ASSERT (RFSTALL overflow at USRP_RX_START, zero SIB1 -- ordinary cold-start RF variance) and attempt 2 was RF-valid but structurally cannot produce a replay.bin per root_cause above. A 3rd attempt would re-run the identical deterministic code path and cannot produce a different outcome; running it anyway would be indistinguishable from tuning/retrying to force a pass, which the plan forbids.

resolution_summary: P02 fix round 2 (controller ruling): two structural gates in the passive-replay recorder both coupled arming to full-auto-only code paths, making it permanently unreachable under the plan's mandatory manual mode (pdcch_blind_monitor_full_auto=0). DL gate fixed in nr_passive_replay_capture.c's nr_passive_replay_dl() (round 1): sweep_ticket.generation==0 (manual mode, no sweep) now treated as an already-settled ticket. UL gate fixed in nr_pdcch_blind_monitor_rt.c's UL candidate loop (round 2, found via live LOG_I instrumentation on capture sensing_manual_fixed.LH2I9w/Ma654f): nr_passive_replay_ul() was called only inside `if(cand_task[ti].ok && cand_task[ti].ul_auto)`, so ul_seen never became true in manual mode; moved to fire on `if (cand_task[ti].ok)` alone, independent of ul_auto. With both fixes, capture sensing_manual_fixed.UtvBT7 (binary c3810019905f3fb661138d12fd5b9b6156d47e36344ae871f08047ba65dc7889) produced 'REPLAY READY ... slots=320 UL=24 DL-controls=38' and replay-verified 'REPLAY PASS: identical DL controls=34 failed=0 raw UL=24; no radio opened' (exit 0, 4.463s wall). This is the fixture registered below.
